Specification: This module is a small TLA+ test specification for finite-set operators provided by the FiniteSets module and utility operators from TLC. It declares a single variable x with an initial condition x = 0 and a trivial next-state action x' = x, but the main purpose of the module is to define an invariant-like operator Inv that checks IsFiniteSet and Cardinality on concrete set literals. The checks verify that a two-element string set is finite, the empty set is finite, the empty set has cardinality 0, and the two-element set has cardinality 2, using Print on success and Assert on failure.
IfThenElse: IF IsFiniteSet({"a", "b"}) THEN Print("Test 1 OK", TRUE) ELSE Assert(FALSE, "Test 1 Failed")
IF IsFiniteSet({}) THEN Print("Test 2 OK", TRUE) ELSE Assert(FALSE, "Test 2 Failed")
IF Cardinality({}) = 0 THEN Print("Test 3 OK", TRUE) ELSE Assert(FALSE, "Test 3 Failed")
IF Cardinality({"a", "b"}) = 2 THEN Print("Test 4 OK", TRUE) ELSE Assert(FALSE, "Test 4 Failed")
